meta.description: Educator profiles are visible only to paying schools and families.

title: Educators are visible to members only
lead: Educators on LearningLinks share their profiles only with paying schools and families. Join for 12 months to search and contact them. Educators never pay.

school.title: For schools
school.note: for 12 months · VAT included · no auto-renewal
school.body: See educators looking for full-time or part-time work. Each campus is NT$10,000 for its own 12 months.

family.title: For families
family.note: for 12 months · VAT included · no auto-renewal
family.body: See educators who offer private tutoring and coaching, with their hourly rates.

why.title: Why can't I look around first?
why.body: Educators agreed to share their profiles only with paying members.
